gizmo.title: Lambobin sadarwa
gizmo.description: Nuna mutanen da ke cikin fayil ɗin lambobin sadarwa a matsayin katunan mutum, ambato, tebur ko jeri.

configure.title: Fayil ɗin lambobin sadarwa
configure.description: Ɗora ko zaɓi fayil ɗin lambobin sadarwa na .vcf. Ana karanta katunansa a cikin burauza.

configure.title: Nuna a matsayin
configure.description: Yadda za a gabatar da abin da fayil ɗin ya ƙunsa.

configure.title: Kanun labari
configure.description: Ana nuna shi a saman lambobin sadarwa, kuma a matsayin taken tebur.
